drhp.business: Kratikal Tech Limited develops and provides cybersecurity and software solutions to domestic and international customers, including AI-driven security awareness, phishing simulation, learning management, email security and related services. The Company operates in India's IT-BPM and cybersecurity industry through two platforms: Threatcop (People Security Management) and AutoSecT (Technology & Process Security Services), pursuing a 'land and expand' go-to-market model.
drhp.end_markets: Domestic India, well spread across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Delhi and Haryana|Exports led by the UAE, supported by new US and UAE subsidiaries
drhp.expansion: As an asset-light cybersecurity/IT services company, expansion is described in terms of geographic and platform footprint rather than physical capacity: the Company is deepening its US and UAE presence through overseas subsidiaries and continuing to scale its AutoSecT platform, supporting a rise in exports (from 13.05% of revenue in FY24 to 29.94% in FY26, led by the UAE) alongside its 'land and expand' go-to-market approach.

litigation.note: Statutory auditors' report (CARO clause) states the Company does not have any pending litigations which would impact its financial position.

drhp.mdna: Sustained double-digit growth in the Indian cybersecurity market, estimated to grow from USD 1.98 Bn (CY2019) to USD 13.60 Bn (CY2025E)|IT-BPM industry revenue growth, estimated to reach USD 283 Bn by FY25E from USD 167 Bn in FY18, a CAGR of ~7.8%|Regulatory tailwinds from CERT-In, RBI/SEBI CSCRF, DPDP Act 2023, GDPR/HIPAA/PCI DSS driving demand for cybersecurity solutions|Rising exports supported by new US and UAE subsidiaries|Proprietary AI-driven product ecosystem enabling a scalable 'land and expand' model|Margin moderation attributed to strategic investments in US & Middle East expansion
drhp.one_liner: A scaled, multi-vertical cybersecurity platform combining People Security Management (Threatcop) and Technology & Process Security Services (AutoSecT) to address both human-layer and infrastructure-layer cyber risk.

risks.note: The Company transacts with multiple entities in which KMPs or their relatives hold substantial interest (Scalemax Advisors (OPC) Private Limited, Scalemax Ventures LLP, Xrise Ventures LLP, Easenode Tech Private Limited, Yarsha Ventures LLP, Threatcop Inc.), which is a governance/related-party exposure to monitor.

Contingent liabilities related to bank guarantees rose sharply, from Rs. 234.18 lakh (FY24) and Rs. 273.45 lakh (FY25) to Rs. 3,416.01 lakh (FY26), indicating growing client-contract guarantee exposure.
risks.risk: Rising contingent liabilities from bank guarantees

risks.note: Return on Equity Ratio declined -99.617% YoY and Return on Capital Employed declined -63.349% YoY in FY26, both attributed by the Company to the increase in share capital / capital employed following the enlarged equity base.

Working capital borrowing is secured against current assets including trade receivables, carries interest at 9.15% per annum, and is repayable on demand, exposing the Company to refinancing/call risk.
Net Profit Ratio declined -32.760% YoY in FY26, which the Company attributes to sales growth outpacing profit growth.
Debt Service Coverage Ratio fell -12.908% YoY in FY26, attributed by the Company to a decrease in profit.
